slides.head:
Adobe just rebuilt Photoshop
and Premiere for an AI chip.
Up to 2x faster.
slides.body: Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D are now optimized for NVIDIA's new RTX Spark superchip. Adobe claims up to 2x faster AI processing, editing, color and effects.

slides.head: Inside Premiere.
slides.body: Playback, rendering, color and effects get RTX acceleration. Enhance Speech and Object Mask get faster too.

slides.head:
Photoshop,
rearchitected.
slides.body: The app is rebuilt around GPU-accelerated compositing. Adobe's examples are the Remove Tool, Gaussian Blur and Light Leaks.

slides.head: Frame.io, 5x.
slides.body: In the cloud, Frame.io moves media processing to NVIDIA GPUs. Early tests show about 5x faster embedding generation and an 80 percent smaller search proxy.

slides.head:
Your edit bay
is about to get faster.
slides.body: Adobe and NVIDIA show the work at Adobe MAX, Nov 10 to 12 in Miami Beach. No ship dates for the apps yet.
